title: Settings API hooks
definitionOfDone: useAuthConfig() fetch auth configuration (OAuth, basic, etc.)

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/hooks/useSettings.ts: useConfig() fetching GET /api/v1/config. useSetConfig() mutation (PUT /api/v1/config). useAuthConfig() — re-exports from hooks/useAuthConfig.ts for consistency. useApiKeys() fetching GET /api/v1/auth/keys. useCreateApiKey() mutation (POST /api/v1/auth/keys with { name, scopes }). useRevokeApiKey() mutation (DELETE /api/v1/auth/keys/:id). useUsers() fetching GET /api/v1/users. useCreateUser() mutation (POST /api/v1/users with { username, password, role }). useUpdateUser() mutation. useDeleteUser() mutation. All admin-only endpoints — hooks should handle 403 gracefully.
